pages.title: Shoot the Bubbles
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Shoot the Bubbles gives you colored bubbles to fire into a cluster. Aim for a group that will have at least three bubbles of the same color after your shot. Use special bubbles to set up bigger clears. Work through the Adventure levels or try to keep the board under control in endless Challenge Mode.

pages.title: Blocky Run
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Blocky Run is a chase runner where a police officer stays close behind you. Jump past hazards as the course pushes you forward, and use power-ups when the next stretch gets tight. See how long you can keep the run going. As you play, you can unlock new looks for your runner.

pages.title: Loop Ghost
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Loop Ghost is a puzzle where your previous attempts become part of the solution. A ghost repeats the moves you made in its cycle. Use that repetition to hold a button or open a passage while you move somewhere else. Plan what each version of you needs to do so you can reach the exit together.

pages.title: Obby - Escape Barry's jail parkour
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Obby - Escape Barry's jail parkour sends you through Barry's prison on an obstacle course. Jump across platforms and keep moving through the jail to avoid getting caught. Look at where you need to land before committing to a jump. Work your way from one section of the prison to the next to escape.

pages.title: Terra Craft World
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Terra Craft World is an open-world sandbox about exploring, building and surviving. Set out to see what the terrain offers, then choose where to put up your structures. Keep the surrounding hazards in mind as you move farther from your starting area. You decide where to explore and what to build along the way.

pages.title: Cookie monster
pages.creator: Starodymov Games
pages.description: Cookie monster is a drawing puzzle about feeding hungry monsters. Draw lines to give the snacks a path to the monster's mouth. Look at where each piece starts before drawing so you can guide the whole batch. The level is complete once every snack has made it into the mouth.

pages.title: Flag Master: World Flags Quiz
pages.creator: TapZap Studio
pages.description: Flag Master: World Flags Quiz mixes flag recognition with geography challenges. Recreate flags by painting them or putting their pieces together. Other tasks ask you to identify capitals or match neighboring countries. Switch between these challenges to practice recognizing flags as well as placing their countries in the wider world.

pages.title: Animal Basketball
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Animal Basketball pairs animal characters with physics-based basketball. Get the ball through the hoop and see how it responds to your shots. Play arcade rounds, enter a championship or take on specific missions. The game offers over a hundred balls to unlock as you work through the different courts and modes.

pages.title: Labuba Merge
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Labuba Merge is a drop-and-merge puzzle where matching Labubas turn into larger characters. Choose where to drop each one so it can reach its match. Watch the space left around the larger pieces, since they change where later drops can land. Keep merging to see which Labuba appears next.

pages.title: Block Up
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Block Up is an arcade game where you guide a block upward through an endless course. Time your moves around barriers of contrasting colors and collect points as you go. The pace rises the farther you get. Watch the next barrier early so you have time to react before it crosses your path.

pages.title: Bunny Boy Online
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Bunny Boy Online is a multiplayer shooter with several maps and modes. Fight with different weapons and use grenades when opponents gather in one area. Join a match with friends and adapt your approach to the current mode. Watch the routes on each map as you look for a good place to engage.

pages.title: Spin Shot Siege
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Spin Shot Siege puts you on a gun tower that rotates automatically while enemy tanks circle the other way. Watch their paths and tap to fire when one lines up with the gun. Different stages use triangles, rectangles, circles and diamonds. Destroy every tank before the ammunition runs out.

pages.title: Chaos Road Combat Car Racing
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Chaos Road Combat Car Racing is a road shooter where your vehicle fires automatically. Steer into position to hit other vehicles and pick up upgrades. Grab a magnet to draw in nearby items while you keep moving. When you reach the boss, dodge its shots and keep your own fire aimed at it.

pages.title: Zombie Last Survivor
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Zombie Last Survivor puts you behind a wooden fence in a first-person fight against zombies. Start with a revolver and take out the different attackers as they close in. Survive waves to unlock stronger weapons and pick up tools such as grenades and Molotovs. Use them to hold the barricade through the next attack.

pages.title: Noob Fuse
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Noob Fuse is a demolition game about finding crystals hidden inside buildings. Use bombs and a lighter to break your way in and reach the chest hidden in each structure. Decide where to place explosives so they open a route to the cache. The buildings range from small houses to larger targets.

pages.title: 2048 Lines
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: 2048 Lines is a fast-moving number puzzle. Send numbered cubes into the lanes and bring equal values together to make larger numbers. Look at which lane will give you a useful merge before sending the next cube. Keep combining values while the board is in motion to raise your score.

pages.title: Heavy Jeep Winter Driving
pages.creator: Royale Gamers
pages.description: Heavy Jeep Winter Driving takes you through a snowy town and across wooded hills. Reach the checkpoints and finish before time runs out. Watch for other vehicles while collecting fuel, gifts, trophies and coins. Keep an eye on the road when you go after a pickup so you can get back on course.

pages.title: Chibi Sup Color
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Chibi Sup Color lets you color a Halloween greeting card featuring chibi superheroes or animals. Pick a design and choose a palette for the character and the rest of the picture. Try different colors on the small details before finishing the card. Take a screenshot if you want to share the result.

pages.title: 10x10 fill the grid !
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: 10x10 fill the grid ! is a block-placement puzzle on a ten-by-ten board. Fit shapes into the available spaces until you complete a line and clear it. Check the empty areas before placing a large piece. Filling a line can give you room for a shape that would otherwise be hard to place.

pages.title: Huggy Wuggy Pop It Jigsaw
pages.creator: Best Games
pages.description: Huggy Wuggy Pop It Jigsaw offers six pictures to assemble. Choose one of three modes and drag the pieces into place. Look for matching colors and edges as you rebuild the Pop It image. Once you finish, pick another picture or change the mode to try a different layout.

pages.title: AI Vendetta
pages.creator: Podge Games
pages.description: AI Vendetta is an arcade shooter where the scenery can become a weapon. Break sections loose so they fall onto the droids below and build a combo. Pick up power-ups and take on bosses as you work through the stages. Each level has a medal rating to improve on a later attempt.

pages.title: Candy Pop
pages.creator: Bizogames.com
pages.description: Candy Pop is a match-three puzzle with candies and cookies. Make groups of three or more to clear pieces and work through the level objective. A match of four or more can create a special candy with a stronger effect. Look for a chance to make one when a smaller match would leave the board crowded.

pages.title: New Years Kigurumi
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: New Years Kigurumi lets you dress Eliza and Jacqueline for a New Year's pajama party. Choose makeup, slippers and a kigurumi for each character. Try a tiger, unicorn or dragon suit, or pick a holiday design such as a Christmas tree. Finish getting them ready and settle in with hot chocolate.

pages.title: Laser Ray
pages.creator: trezegames
pages.description: Laser Ray is a timed puzzle about reflecting light onto diamonds. Adjust the lasers and mirrors so the beams reach every diamond on the board. Follow the beam after each change to see which targets still need light. You have two minutes to work out the arrangement, with sixty levels to solve.

pages.title: Emoji Mahjong
pages.creator: OneTwoPlay IT
pages.description: Emoji Mahjong asks you to find three identical emoji tiles at a time. Remove each matching trio and look for more of the same symbols in the tiles that remain. Pay attention to the arrangement as it changes between levels. Clear the full board by working through each set of matching faces and icons.

pages.title: Halloween Tiles
pages.creator: MathNook
pages.description: Halloween Tiles is a collapse puzzle where clearing tiles makes the columns fall. Watch what comes together after each clear so you can find another match. Collapses and additional matches earn Magic Pumpkins. Save the pumpkins for a spot where you need to remove a tile and have no ordinary match available.

pages.title: Roof Rails Online
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Roof Rails Online is a rooftop runner where you carry a wooden pole for balance. Pick up blocks to make the pole longer and stay within the edges of the snowy roofs. Gather gems on the way to the finish. Plan where to move so you can reach useful pickups without stepping off the route.

pages.title: Cyber Racer Battles
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Cyber Racer Battles lets you pilot hover vehicles in races and combat missions. Win solo races to earn coins for other hovers, or try Mission mode for battles on separate maps. Race and Free Roam both support two players as well as solo play. Choose a mode depending on whether you want to compete or explore.

pages.title: Among Them Coloring Book
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Among Them Coloring Book gives you crew-themed pictures to color. Pick colors for the figures and decide how to fill the other parts of the picture. Use different colors to make the crew members easy to tell apart, or give them a shared palette. Finish one picture and try another design.

pages.title: Castel Wars
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Castel Wars is a two-player pixel battle fought around castles. Place small blocks to trap a rival or open an escape, and use the tower catapult for a stronger hit. Watch for the flying character that drops weapons and ammunition. You can also throw your sword when you need a ranged attack.

pages.title: Snow Rider 3D
pages.creator: GameBiz
pages.description: Snow Rider 3D sends a sleigh down a snowy course. Steer around obstacles and keep the sleigh going as far as you can to raise your score. Pick up gifts when there is room to reach them safely. Save the gifts to buy a different sleigh for later runs.

pages.title: Frisbee Forever 2
pages.creator: Kiloo
pages.description: Frisbee Forever 2 puts you in control of a flying disc across more than seventy-five tracks. Guide it through scenery that includes volcanoes, snowy landscapes and countryside rivers. Complete missions, find hidden challenges and level up to unlock more discs. Try to build out the Wham-O Frisbee collection as you explore the three worlds.

pages.title: Sniper Master 3D
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Sniper Master 3D is a rifle game built around carefully aimed shots. Use the mouse to line up a target through the scope before you fire. Watch the space around the target, especially when a hostage is nearby. Take the shot when you have a clear line and work through the missions.

pages.title: Jelly Garden
pages.creator: AF
pages.description: Jelly Garden is a match-three game where you swap colorful jellies to line up matching pieces. Look at what each clear will open up on the board and use larger matches to set up blasts. Work through the different challenges across hundreds of levels and check the layout before choosing your first swap.

pages.title: Little Superheroes Match 3
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Little Superheroes Match 3 asks you to line up three or more pieces of the same color. Keep making matches while watching the gauge on the left. If it drops too low, the round ends. Look for the next combination as soon as the pieces move and see how high you can score.

pages.title: Hole Ball
pages.creator: Ihor Musikevych
pages.description: Hole Ball is an arcade game about guiding a ball across platforms without falling through the holes. Steer toward clear sections and keep climbing. In endless mode, aim to reach a new height. The time trials give you a different goal by asking you to finish the levels as quickly as possible.

pages.title: Word Adventures
pages.creator: Eery Lab s.c.
pages.description: Word Adventures lets you swipe across letters to make words. Find all the words in a puzzle to move through the land and build up the places you visit. Work through the harder letter sets as you advance and unlock up to sixty items along the way. Try a different letter order whenever a word eludes you.

pages.title: Modern City Bus Driving Simulator Game
pages.creator: zuma studio
pages.description: Modern City Bus Driving Simulator Game combines passenger service with a race against opponents and the clock. Pick up passengers as you drive, then drop them at the destination before time runs out. Watch your route between stops and keep the bus moving so you can finish the trip on time.

pages.title: Fun Neon Strike
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Fun Neon Strike gives you red and blue squares and a horizontal line that switches between those colors. Match each square to the line while its color is right. Every correct contact adds a point. Watch for the next color change so you can time the move and keep building your score.

pages.title: Spartacus Arena
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Spartacus Arena is a 3D gladiator combat game. Enter with a sword and shield, a two-handed weapon, a bow or a pair of weapons. Use the mouse to attack or block, and press Space to dive out of danger. Watch how your opponent moves so you can choose when to close the distance.

pages.title: Teddy Blocks
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Teddy Blocks is a puzzle about clearing every block from the board. Click a group of at least two identical neighbors to remove them. Think about which blocks will still have a partner after each clear. A lone piece cannot be removed by itself, so choose the order with the whole board in mind.

pages.title: Combat Zombie Warfare
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Combat Zombie Warfare is a shooter with zombies, soldiers and battles against other players. Pick a weapon and map before entering the fight. Work through the campaign or face other players online. Pay attention to which threats are nearest as you move through each map and decide where to aim.

pages.title: Sky Combat
pages.creator: Parrot Games
pages.description: Sky Combat is an arcade shooter where you fly a plane into enemy formations. Use the mouse to steer while watching the stream of bullets coming toward you. Pick a plane and fight through the opposing aircraft, keeping clear of their fire. Stay in the air as you take on stronger enemies and bosses.

pages.title: Slendrina Must Die: The Celar
pages.creator: danygames.com
pages.description: Slendrina Must Die: The Celar locks you inside a bunker-like cellar. Search for eight books to find a way out alive. Watch the rooms and corridors as you explore, and use the knife, pistol, shotgun or MP5 to deal with threats. Keep looking until you have what you need to escape.

pages.title: Flying Superhero Revenge Grand City Captain
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Flying Superhero Revenge Grand City Captain puts you in charge of a hero who can travel through the city on foot or in the air. Press F to fly, use WASD to move and use the mouse or Q for attacks. Move between the city's rescue and combat missions and use flight to reach the action.

pages.title: Viking Way
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Viking Way is a runner where a Viking keeps moving through a course full of obstacles. Time your jumps so he clears what is in his path. Pick up beer to extend the run and watch the next obstacle as soon as you land. See how far you can get before the run ends.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Fathers Day
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Baby Hazel Fathers Day follows Hazel as she spends Father's Day with her dad. Join them for games, then help Hazel win a gift during a trip to candy land. Finish the celebration with a family outing and a treat. The activities take you from making the gift to spending the day together.

pages.title: BTS Monster Craft Coloring
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: BTS Monster Craft Coloring gives you monster drawings to color. Pick a palette and decide which colors to use on the character and its surroundings. Try different combinations on the small features as you fill out the picture. Finish one monster and then choose another scene to try a different look.

pages.title: ProTon Coach Bus Simulator
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: ProTon Coach Bus Simulator has you drive a passenger coach between cities. Follow the route through an open map and take your passengers to their destination. Account for the size of the bus as you navigate different roads and driving situations. Try the available coaches and see the trip from their interiors.

pages.title: Wild Hunter Sniper Buck
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Wild Hunter Sniper Buck takes you into a jungle to look for deer and other wildlife. Choose a gun with a range that suits the shot, then aim with the mouse. Press R to reload and E to switch on night vision. Look carefully for movement before settling on a target.

pages.title: Checkers 3D
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Checkers 3D brings the diagonal moves and captures of checkers to a board you can view from two perspectives. Look for jumps over opposing pieces while keeping your own pieces protected. Switch between the 3D and 2D cameras whenever another angle helps you read the board and plan your next move.

pages.title: Gyros.io
pages.creator: LoraStudio
pages.description: Gyros.io is an arena game where you steer a spinning top and battle rival tops. Move across the arena and line up a collision when another top is within reach. Watch for opponents coming from the side while you go after a target. Beat the other tops to climb toward first place.

pages.title: Desert Prince Runner
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Desert Prince Runner sends you through the East City and its subway. Move from side to side and jump or slide past obstacles while collecting coins. Choose among four characters and spend coins on themed skins. Watch the route ahead so you can pick the right move before reaching the next barrier.

pages.title: Army of Soldiers Worlds War
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Army of Soldiers Worlds War puts you in charge of defending an unfinished cannon from invaders. Send soldiers to intercept creatures before they reach Alpha Destructor 1. Decide which troops to deploy as each attack develops. Keep the cannon protected while your army holds off the forces coming from other worlds.

pages.title: EG Knife Up
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: EG Knife Up is a timing game where a tap sends the knife upward. Wait for an opening between spikes, knives and other obstacles before making your move. Pick up coins to unlock new knives. Keep climbing through the course and use the same timing when a boss appears.

pages.title: Squad Defense
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Squad Defense is a strategy game where you send soldiers into battle and use three skills to support them. Choose which troops to deploy as the opposition changes. Upgrade your forces to prepare for later stages. There are more than forty levels to work through as you build up the squad.

pages.title: Motorbike Puzzle Challenge
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Motorbike Puzzle Challenge gives you motorcycle pictures to assemble at your own pace. Choose easy, medium or hard before placing the pieces. Look for outlines and colors that continue across neighboring pieces. There is no timer, so you can take your time finding the details that complete each bike.

pages.title: Halloween Car Jigsaw
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Halloween Car Jigsaw offers three Halloween car pictures to put together. Choose a 16-, 36-, 64- or 100-piece layout and look for matching details along the edges of the pieces. Try to complete the image quickly. Switch pictures or raise the piece count when you want a different puzzle.

pages.title: Bobblehead Soccer
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Bobblehead Soccer is a football game where you move a bobblehead player and try to kick the ball into the opposing goal. Use power-ups when they appear and move back to defend after each attack. Work through increasingly tough opponents as you learn how the ball rebounds around the field.

pages.title: Under the sea
pages.creator: TapLabGames
pages.description: Under the sea is a memory game with underwater pictures hidden on cards. Click a card to see its image, then look for another card with the same picture. Remember the cards you turn over so you can find their partners later. Clear the board by matching every underwater pair.

pages.title: Ball Way
pages.creator: Super Games
pages.description: Ball Way is a physics puzzle where you arrange pieces to guide a ball to its destination. Move or rotate the pieces before launching the ball. Watch where it rolls or bounces, then adjust the route if it misses the goal. Different objects, including portals and obstacles, change how you build the path.

pages.title: Valentine's Day Shopping
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Valentine's Day Shopping lets you help a princess choose an outfit for Valentine's Day. Look through the available clothes and pick accessories that go with the pieces you like. Try more than one combination before settling on a look. The aim is to put together an outfit for the occasion.

pages.title: PRECO
pages.creator: Xpresate Studio
pages.description: PRECO follows a child and a robot into an ancient cave to look for evidence that giants once existed. Use the left and right arrow keys to guide the robot through the cavern. Watch for spikes and other hazards along the way. Keep the robot moving safely as the pair investigate what is underground.

pages.title: Brain For Monster Truck
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Brain For Monster Truck is a physics puzzle where you draw the road yourself. Drag to sketch a route across the gaps and use the eraser to remove a line that gets in the way. Drive the truck along your route and try to collect stars while getting it and its cargo to the finish.

pages.title: Brick Breaker Levels
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Brick Breaker Levels is a paddle-and-ball game about clearing bricks to meet the level goal. Move the paddle under the ball as it comes back and send it toward the bricks that remain. Watch the rebound so you have time to get into position. Clear the required bricks to move on.

pages.title: Match 3 Forest
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Match 3 Forest sets patterned spheres among the branches of a tree. Line up three matching spheres horizontally or vertically to remove them. Bigger matches unlock special options that help with later clears. Try to make larger groups when the layout allows, or take on the timed mode and race the clock.

pages.title: Freekick Training
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Freekick Training is a football shooting game with fifteen levels. Aim the ball toward the goal and adjust the kick when something blocks the direct route. The setups become more demanding as you advance, so look at the space around the target before taking each free kick. Clear the challenges to finish training.

pages.title: Bomb It TD
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Bomb It TD asks you to defend your hearts from aliens, robots and monsters. Build turrets on walls and place traps on the ground. Use a fast turret to cover a route, a slower one for heavier hits, or a mine for a single blast. Watch where enemies enter before placing your defenses.

pages.title: Pop Star Princess Dresses
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Pop Star Princess Dresses helps a princess get ready to go onstage as a singer. Start by choosing eye shadow and lipstick, then find an outfit that works with the makeup. Try different combinations to see how the colors look together. The finished outfit is her look for the fans.

pages.title: Baby Princess Birthday Party
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Baby Princess Birthday Party puts you in charge of getting Erika ready for her birthday. Decorate the room with balloons, gifts and other party ornaments. Then choose a dress and accessories for the birthday girl. Try different decorations and clothing until both Erika and the room are ready for the celebration.

pages.title: Tiles of the Unexpected
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Tiles of the Unexpected gives you a layered wall of tiles to clear. Remove adjacent groups with the same design and let unsupported pieces fall into place. Matches caused by the collapse earn bombs. When no group moves remain, use those bombs on single tiles to keep clearing the wall.

pages.title: Princess Valentine's Chaos
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Princess Valentine's Chaos follows four princesses who lose their memories after Maleficent casts a spell. Help Elsa, Ariel, Belle and Jasmine complete the tasks that undo it. Once a princess remembers her partner, choose outfits for the couple. Work through the four stories to get everyone ready for Valentine's Day.

pages.title: Ice Queen Makeover Time
pages.creator: Daria Games
pages.description: Ice Queen Makeover Time gives you a queen to prepare for a special event. Choose lipstick and glittery eye shadow, then style her hair and try on different clothes. Finish with accessories that work with the outfit. Go back to earlier choices if you want the makeup to match a different look.
